meta.description: Review, improve, organize, deploy, and verify Grafana dashboards, provisioned alert rules, and the Telegraf→InfluxDB→Grafana monitoring stack. Use when working on Grafana dashboards, dashboard folders, tags, legends, panel readability, Flux/InfluxDB queries, Prometheus/Telegraf dimensions, Telegraf JSON/HTTP scraping, anonymous access, dashboard/alert provisioning, Grafana Docker deployments, provisioned alert rules and Flux alert conditions, contact points and Telegram/notification delivery, or requests like "review this dashboard", "optimize Grafana panels", "fix legends", "move dashboards into a folder", "add tags", "set up Grafana alerting", "alert won't fire / won't deliver", "fix Telegram alerts", "route alerts to a Telegram topic/thread (message_thread_id)", "bump/upgrade the Grafana version", "deploy and verify dashboards", or "Grafana best practices".
